title: The Retreat at Dazzling Dennis Near Nash & Lake
description:
Welcome to your own private retreat - a beautifully furnished 2 bedroom home with modern style, soaring ceilings and a striking exposed bean that gives the space warmth and character.  

Step inside to a bright, open concept living area designed for both comfort and style.  The modern kitchen features high-end, full-size appliances and flows seamlessly into the living space, making it easy to cook, unwind or simply enjoy a quiet evening at home.
